## SCUM Tactical Map & Chat Translator v2.4.0

### Highlights
- 🔗 **Players database, fully automatic**: the app reads all your game logs (current and old) and keeps every nickname with the player's permanent SteamID. No typing of SteamIDs. If a player renames, the new name replaces the old one everywhere, including on your bases.
- 🗺 **Clickable Steam profiles on the map**: hover a base to see its players. 🔗 opens the Steam profile; a name with ▾ shows the old nicknames with the date of each change.
- ⚙ **New Settings → Players page**: all collected players with clickable SteamIDs, old nicknames, search, and delete buttons (every delete asks for confirmation, including "clear all"). A switch turns collecting off entirely.

### Added
- Settings → Players: nickname ↔ SteamID list with dated nickname history, delete old nickname / delete player / clear all (always confirmed).
- **Collect SteamIDs** switch (on by default). Off: nothing is read or stored. On: all current and old logs are scanned.
- First launch reads every existing log (including old `SCUM-backup-*.log`); later starts read only what is new.

### Changed
- Base players are entered as nicknames only; known players are linked automatically (current or old nickname) and follow renames.
- The map hover card appears under the cursor and stays open so links can be clicked.

### Fixed
- The player registry was not filled while the game was running (nickname and SteamID were passed in swapped order).

### Notes
- Only the in-game nickname from the game log is used, never the Steam display name.
- `players.json` is user data: it is never touched by updates.

### First launch
Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC" the first time. This is normal for free unsigned apps and is **not** a virus warning: click **More info → Run anyway** once. Details in the [README](https://github.com/tankow79/scum-ui-translator-map#-windows-says-protected-your-pc--is-this-a-virus).

### Files
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator.exe`: standard build
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator_Portable.exe`: portable build
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator_v2.4.0.zip`: exe + instructions

`config.json`, `points.json`, `profiles.json` and `players.json` are not shipped: the app creates them next to the exe on first launch.

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/tankow79/scum-ui-translator-map/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
